releaseNotes: Fixes the IndexedDB connection-closing race at the end of updates. Stale connections are invalidated on version changes or unexpected closes, and one failed transaction is retried on a fresh connection. The existing platform database, cache identity and student data are preserved.
Chrome Android is synchronized with the latest To Me application logic and study features, while its Android-only identity and existing local storage remain unchanged.
First-install Setup now appears immediately after Splash. It downloads and verifies the complete offline package before question-bank loading, app-module preloads or onboarding can begin.

Returning installs open from the verified local package without a blocking setup screen or full-package scan. One updater checks the manifest every 48 hours or manually, stages only changed files, verifies them and commits safely.

Adds 242 verified supplementary AI Clinical Cases questions across the ten medical systems, with four new topics. Preserves each source case, question, option, key, explanation and provenance; the duplicate Proteus question is not imported.
Gives every topic a matching medical illustration in the Nephrotic Syndrome glossy blue icon style. Existing topic artwork is retained; missing topics receive a unique subject-aware illustration.

AI Clinical Cases now displays case text directly inside the first linked question card, without case numbers, titles or CONTINUED labels. Adds a newly authored, diagnosis-neutral clinical vignette for CVS Q1 (VSD); the remaining introductory CVS questions stay independent. Existing question stems, options, answer keys and explanations are preserved.

Serves the verified offline package locally first for the page, scripts, styles and assets; successful network fallbacks are cached. Only the scheduled/manual updater checks and integrity downloads bypass the local copy. Shortens the Splash-to-app portal handoff from about 2.86 s to about 0.85 s.

Prevents the startup splash from revealing Home before every deferred app script has completed; startup stays behind the splash until the complete renderer is ready, and the duplicate late Home redraw is removed.

Removes the retired design-prototype interface: sidebar, handoff panels, guide/document views, mock in-app screens and intermediate legacy Subjects renderer. The live Home and question-bank engine are now the only in-app render path. Splash, first-run onboarding, student data, offline package and update storage remain preserved.

AI Clinical Cases and AI Generated now feed the same Dr. Al-Joaki question engine, question cards, answer state, Save and Personal note controls; their source data and separate progress remain independent.
The two AI banks now participate in Quiz and Smart Review bank selection. Quiz topic choices are scoped to the chosen bank and system, and saved AI quiz attempts are retained across app restarts.
Retires the separate AI question renderers and blocks their legacy page routes. The current Home is redrawn after all startup scripts finish to prevent a stale first screen.
Fixes AI Clinical Cases topic-to-case-to-questions navigation and retains the shared compact question-card styling.
Updates bank validation to recognize Egyptian Book styling inside the consolidated late CSS bundle.
Shows the cinematic splash on every app open. The seven-day interval applies only to automatic update checks, not the splash.
Consolidates the CSS cascade into bundle-core.css and bundle-late.css in their original order; source sheets are preserved under _layers/css/original/.
Routes AI Clinical Cases through system → topic → case → questions; each case now owns a visually grouped vignette and its linked questions.
Aligns AI Generated page and question-card classes with the shared Pediatrics bank styling.
Defers Service Worker-triggered reloads until the accepted offline package has passed size and SHA-256 checks and has been committed; first installation does not reload.
Fixes repeated 28 MB offline restores by keeping the verified package cache stable across app releases; hash comparison now downloads only changed or genuinely missing files.
Shows the cinematic splash once every seven days, not on every app open or after an update restart.
Removes the unconditional Service Worker update check on every launch; installed Chrome apps check on the seven-day schedule and manual Check for updates remains available.
Restores the bank-origin resolver in the shared collection bridge so all independent Pediatrics question banks initialize correctly.
Starts the offline setup script immediately after the Embedded images marker so offline-state detection and package-list loading begin during the splash.
Prevents a page reload when the Service Worker first takes control; later controller changes retain the normal reload behavior.
Reduces the Service Worker install shell to the nine essential files. Remaining verified package assets are handled by the offline setup screen.
AI Clinical Cases and AI Generated now use the Dr. Al-Joaki layout with unique icons and unified system names.
Restores the independent Previous Questions collection with all 399 original exam questions; the numeric source marker is respected and stale cached bank labels cannot hide them.
Keeps the three independent collections correctly identified: Previous Questions (399), Clinical Cases (90) and AI Clinical Cases (1,598).
Unifies the question-card presentation across Previous Questions, Clinical Cases and AI Clinical Cases; all collections retain independent content and progress.
AI Clinical Cases bank 07 opens a selected topic directly to its linked questions, showing each shared case history once above its questions.
Restores the 399-question Previous Questions archive in its original separate collection.
Keeps the 1,598-question AI Clinical Cases bank and the independent 90-question Clinical Cases bank as two distinct collections.
Preserves the archived Previous Questions source data and all existing student progress. No question records, answer keys, bookmarks, notes or saved progress were cleared.
Fixes the Exam Goal Planner ? Study Hub storage-key mismatch so saved exam dates and daily targets appear consistently. Repairs corrupted punctuation in offline-install and update messages.
Pre-caches all 16 AI Generated MCQ data shards and its bank renderer with the new release, so the complete 1,881-question bank is available from one consistent offline cache.

Loads AI Generated shards four at a time, applies an 18-second per-file timeout and one network-bypassing retry, and validates the assembled 1,881-question bank before rendering. This prevents indefinite loading while preserving every question and saved answer.
Keeps startup fail-closed: if a required deferred app script fails twice, the app shows a recovery screen rather than exposing a partially loaded legacy interface.

Prevents intermittent legacy/mixed-version screens: Chrome now checks the Service Worker on app launch, reloads once when a new worker takes control, and fetches the current HTML, JavaScript and CSS before falling back to verified offline copies. The offline cache namespace is rotated; question data and student progress are preserved.

Retires the obsolete #notes design-handoff route; the production app opens directly without exposing prototype navigation or handoff panels. All app screens, banks, progress storage and offline assets remain intact.

Restores all eight named Pediatrics collections: Dr. Abdulrahman Al-Joaki MCQ, Previous Questions, Clinical Cases, AI Generated, Nelson Textbook, Kasr Al-Ainy, AI Clinical Cases, and Egyptian Book. The first four appear first; each collection opens its own content.
Preserves the original Faculty of Medicine, University of Tripoli logo for Previous Questions and restores the supplied emblems for the other collections.

Completes short and cross-reference explanations in the base question bank. The question checker now reports zero warnings and zero errors; original missing option letters and duplicated options remain unchanged and are explicitly documented as source-faithful exceptions.
Removes numeric bank labels from the student-facing Clinical Cases and AI Generated screens. Internal file identifiers remain unchanged.
Updates the offline cache version so installed Chrome PWA copies can receive the corrected collection chooser and question explanations.

Places Clinical Case (1,598 questions across 10 medical systems) third and AI Generated (1,881 single-best-answer MCQs from 16 source files) fourth in the Pediatrics collection chooser; remaining collections stay available.
Uses the supplied University of Tripoli, Clinical Cases, AI Generated, Nelson, Kasr Al-Ainy, AI Clinical Cases and Egyptian Book badge artwork as optimized WebP bank icons.
Reuses the Dr. Al-Joaki system and disease/topic artwork in the Clinical Case and AI Generated banks wherever a matching topic exists, with semantic icons retained as a fallback.

Adds Arabic-aware shared search normalisation, removes redundant search-index text duplication, groups search controls into a collapsible Filters panel, and adds unit tests plus a PWA GitHub Actions check.

Adds AI Generated collection: AI Generated — 1,881 standard MCQs across 31 medical systems and 295 topics, assembled from 16 MSQ source files. Navigation is Medical System → Topic → Questions, with no clinical-case stage. Answer feedback and initial explanations appear after selection; Read More expands the detailed explanation, high-yield points and source. Progress is stored separately from every other bank. Difficulty-classification fields and UI are not included.

Adds Clinical Cases collection: Clinical Case to the live unified Chrome PWA: 1,598 validated questions across 10 medical systems, 284 source-organized topics and 330 case groups. Navigation is Medical System → Topic → Clinical Case → Questions. Clinical Cases collection has a separate answer-progress store and preserves the existing Pediatrics Clinical Cases collection and all other bank progress.

Forces a clean offline-cache refresh for this release. The Service Worker and offline installer share the cache namespace derived from the current release version, so installed copies download the current application shell instead of retaining files from the previous release.

Quiz: choose several banks, several systems and several topics together (a topic is also matched in banks that have no topic labels, by its name). Clear icons for Nelson, Clinical Cases, Kasr Al-Ainy and Egyptian Book. Arabic exam labels and Arabic reviewer notes are no longer shown in explanations or sources.

Fixes a syntax error in js/09-app-features-v6.js that stopped the main app script from loading. Fixes the build version guard. Question cards no longer show the id/status/tag chips or topic title; the All Questions and All Tags filters now work in every bank; Quiz, Search and Smart Review use six separate banks (Dr. Al-Joaki, Previous Questions, Nelson Textbook, Kasr Al-Ainy, Clinical Cases, Egyptian Book); progress can be reset by bank, then system, then topic; the Smart Review intro shows only until the first session; explanations are organised and keep their High-yield notes; Back from a system list returns to the list of banks; Egyptian Book has its own icon.

Renames All Once to Kasr Al-Ainy; removes Curriculum alignment paragraphs from displayed explanations across question banks; makes Egyptian Book answer UI English-only; fixes Phone/Browser Back to return from a medical system to its collection list.
Fixes All Once question filtering after Clinical Case integration. Egyptian Book now opens all questions directly after selecting a medical system, without a Topics screen.

Adds the independent English-language Egyptian Book Pediatrics collection, organized by medical system and topic. 466 Accepted questions with complete answer keys are student-facing; 7 Accepted records with unresolved answer keys remain excluded.

DRAFT — adds a separate Clinical Cases Pediatrics collection with 90 recoverable Accepted cards (81 MCQ and 9 open-ended), 13 system-specific Markdown explanation files, and preserved source provenance. 59 Accepted sections without a dedicated question block remain in an audit file and are excluded until their exact stems are reconstructed; this candidate is not production-ready.
Adds a separate All Once Pediatrics collection with 998 question cards built from Accepted and Needs Review Markdown only; exact duplicates are removed and multi-part questions are separated.

All Once questions are grouped by source medical system, retain their source references, show an initial explanation and expandable Read More detail, and keep workflow/review-status tags out of the question cards.
Questions with OCR-damaged options or unresolved/multiple answer keys remain answer-disabled rather than having a guessed key inserted.
The existing Dr. Al-Joaki, Previous Questions and Nelson Textbook collections remain separate and unchanged.
Refreshes the offline cache again so all installed Chrome copies load the corrected 13-system Nelson list.
Restores Nelson Urology as the 13th medical system, showing its 14 questions instead of leaving them out of the system list.
Rotates the Chrome offline cache so previously installed copies stop serving stale Pediatrics scripts and receive the current Nelson bank UI.
Refreshes the Nelson collection UI and offline content manifest so installed Chrome copies can receive the latest verified files.
Adds a dedicated Nelson Textbook of Pediatrics cover image and removes the empty topic label from Nelson's system-only question cards.
Fixes Nelson questions not appearing when the selected study grade does not include Pediatrics; Nelson remains accessible across grades.
Removes Nelson review-status tags and flagged counters while preserving safeguards for incomplete questions; removes the Study Hub panel from Home.
Adds the separate Nelson Textbook Pediatrics question collection from the curated Markdown files in Nelson.zip, including Core, Extended, Accepted and Review material.
Nelson questions are grouped by medical system only; selecting a system opens its questions directly, reusing existing system icons.
Nelson explanations show an initial beginner-friendly explanation and an expandable Read More section, with the Nelson source at the end of the expanded explanation.
Incomplete OCR questions remain flagged and answer selection is disabled when the stem or options are incomplete.
Continues the independent unified Chrome PWA for phone and computer. Android APK, iOS and Computer deliveries remain separate.
Smart Review opens directly at Your Session; Smart Recommended remains available as a compact action within the session panel.
Overview keeps its statistics, topic mastery map and mastery journey while removing the due-today / 20-question hero card only.
Empty Schedule state no longer displays the redundant Choose a topic button.
Pediatrics Start Studying opens the collection chooser first. The doctor MCQ bank and Previous Questions remain separate and are grouped by their existing system/topic mapping.
The side menu keeps the existing Exam Goal Planner under Your Progress and removes the duplicate extension entry.
Question bank records, stable question IDs, question wording, option labels, answer keys and explanations are preserved.
Fixes offline installation integrity retries by bypassing stale Service Worker cache responses for hash-versioned verification requests, while storing verified bytes under canonical local cache URLs.

Offline retry reuses the previously saved package cache, rechecks existing files against the current byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and downloads only missing or changed assets. The latest Service Worker is checked and activated before integrity downloads.
After the complete current package passes integrity verification, obsolete cache entries and older package caches are deleted. Existing answers, bookmarks, notes and study progress remain preserved.
Pediatrics collection navigation now renders the registered collection chooser correctly from Start Studying, with the doctor MCQ and Previous Questions paths available.
Removed the Smart Recommended card and its Start recommended action entirely from Smart Review, as requested.

Reworked Pediatrics Start Studying to use the existing Pediatrics specialties route and collection chooser; removed the unsupported custom page registration shim that could leave the Start action unresponsive.
Pediatrics 'Start Studying' and 'Continue Studying' now work: the collection and home scripts are connected to the app core through a safe bridge (no data or markup changes).
Added a Question bank selector (All banks / Dr. Al-Joaki / Previous) to Quiz, Search and Smart Review. It is a view-only filter; question records, IDs, answer keys and explanations are unchanged.
A question opened from Search, Saved, Wrong answers or Smart Review now opens inside its own bank, so a Previous question no longer opens as an empty list.
summary: First-install Setup appears immediately after Splash, before question-bank data, app modules or onboarding load; every required package file is verified by byte size and SHA-256.
Returning installs start from the saved local package. One updater checks every 48 hours or manually, downloads only changed files, and safely stages and applies them after verification.
The existing Chrome Android Cache Storage name, IndexedDB database, answers, bookmarks, notes and study progress are preserved.
